title: HIDE YOU cited web / deep-research controller
language_justification: Matches the existing offline retrieval and cognition side (ramanujan/search.py, ramanujan/cognition.py, ramanujan/evidence.py); LIGHT_ONLY fixture tests with no Cargo/network weight.
network: forbidden — every test uses committed fixture documents under ramanujan/fixtures/you_research_corpus.json

capabilities.multi_source_retrieval: Retriever protocol + FakeRetriever (token-overlap over fixtures; not an embedding model, not a reranker)
capabilities.contradiction_detection: detect_contradictions — records unresolved_both_surfaced, preferred_claim_id always null
capabilities.freshness_checks: freshness_for_claim — source captured_at + age/stale at answer_at

properties.name: four_way_separation
properties.law: RetrievedFact | ModelInference | UserProvided | UncertainHypothesis are distinct ClaimCategory values. Claim is a frozen dataclass; category mutation is a type error. The only graph path that changes category is transition_category(), which records a CategoryTransition (reason + actor + from/to).

properties.name: evidence_binding_binary
properties.law: Every factual claim (RetrievedFact, UserProvided) is either EvidenceBinding.LINKED (with citation_ids) or EvidenceBinding.UNSUPPORTED (with empty citation_ids). There is no third state. Claim.assert_evidence_law() / graph.add_claim() enforce this.

properties.name: web_not_auto_durable
properties.law: DurableMemory is a separate store. ResearchController.run never writes it. Promotion is only via promote_to_memory / DurableMemory.promote with non-empty actor and reason, and is recorded as MemoryPromotion.

properties.name: contradiction_surfaces_both
properties.law: Two sources disagreeing on the same subject+value produces a Contradiction with resolution=unresolved_both_surfaced and preferred_claim_id=null. Higher grade and newer source are never auto-selected. record_contradiction refuses a preferred side.

properties.name: freshness
properties.law: Every CapturedDocument carries captured_at. Every RetrievedFact carries source_captured_at. At answer time, freshness_for_claim reports age_seconds and stale against a threshold.

claim_evidence_graph_relation.summary: ClaimEvidenceGraph composes ramanujan.cognition.ResearchObjectGraph rather than inventing a second dependency/refutation lattice.
how: Sources, documents, citations, and claims are nodes in that graph (kinds: source, document, citation, claim).
Dependencies: claim → citation → document → source (via ResearchObjectGraph.depend).
Refutation: ClaimEvidenceGraph.refute_source / refute_claim call ResearchObjectGraph.refute, which propagates transitively — the same mechanism locked by ramanujan/test_cognition.py.
Claim metadata (category, evidence binding, transitions, contradictions) lives beside the graph in ClaimEvidenceGraph fields; it does not duplicate depends_on or propagation.
claim_evidence_graph_relation.evidence_tier_lattice: ramanujan.evidence.Tier is attached on ROG nodes at registration (ASSERTED for claims/sources; EMPIRICALLY_SUPPORTED for citations). Promotion across tiers remains the verifier-gated path in evidence.py; the YOU controller does not invent a parallel promotion rule.

non_goals_honored: no real reranker — FakeRetriever is token-overlap and named honestly

reuse.fixture_style: same offline NON_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY pattern as ramanujan/search.py PremiseRetrieval

light_md.note: Task required reading _LIGHT.md; file was not present. LIGHT_ONLY / no-network rules from the task prompt and HAWKING_LIGHT_ONLY_* status were followed.
